page.layout: One printed page on the right side of the scan, with a text block of running Latin and a few partly covered lines; a grey digitiser's test card covers the left and centre of the scan. Top of page: running head and page number at the top right. Text is mostly hidden under the card; only fragments of the right-hand lines are visible.
page.notes: The test card (BSB / digitalfoto-trainer calibration target with scale bars, grey wedge and star targets) covers most of the page and is not printed text, so it is omitted. Only fragments of the right-hand column are legible: "AE;", "IANVM", "TRI,", "O nato,", "XCVI.", "bri." and a catchword-like line "cap. Fin." at the foot. Most of the text is illegible under the card, so the transcription above is not reliable and the line marked with ellipsis is a placeholder for unreadable text, not a faithful copy. The running head and page number at the top right are partly visible and uncertain.
